name: Ichikikushikino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ichikikushikino city emblem in navy, blue and red: a navy and blue stylised figure with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ichikikushikino, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 October 2005.

features.role: Ichikikushikino city emblem — a navy and blue stylised figure with a red disc
